- [LFCA.1.4] **This catalog's membership.** This document specifies
  the construct capabilities of [LCAP.1] in `actions`,
  `series_capability`, `call_modifiers` and `expression_capability`, and
  nothing else. Its size is stated once, at [LFCA.10.2].

  The storage and samples-plane capabilities are deferred with the storage
  layer they gate ([LSTO.2], [LSTO.3]). They stay in the registry, every
  program and dialect sets them `false`, and they are specified at
  [LCAP.2.10]. The `hydration` category ([LFCA.4]) is deferred with them.

  A name or number `proto/capabilities.proto#Capability` reserves is out of
  use and is never reused ([STYL.2.8.7]), so a dialect naming a reserved
  name gets `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY` rather than a setting
  that does nothing.
